newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-DEION SANDERS TO RETURN TO BASEBALL WITH REDS.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-DEION SANDERS TO RETURN TO BASEBALL WITH REDS.

text.p: Deion Sanders will once again be a two-sport star after signing a contract to return to major league baseball with the Cincinnati Reds, the team announced on Thursday.

Sanders, who sat out the 1996 baseball season to concentrate on playing football for the Dallas Cowboys, signed a one-year contract with the Reds with a mutual option year. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Sanders, one of the fastest players in the National Football League, played both cornerback and wide receiver for the Dallas Cowboys this past season after putting his baseball career on the back burner.

He won a Super Bowl with the San Francisco 49ers in 1995, then signed a highly-publicised seven-year, $35 million contract with the Cowboys in September of 1995. He won another Super Bowl in his first season with Dallas.
Sanders, who also played in baseball's World Series with the Atlanta Braves, had been without a baseball contract since finishing the 1995 season with San Francisco Giants.

This will mark Sanders's second stint with Cincinnati. He went to the Giants from the Reds in an eight-player trade in July of 1995 and hit .285 with five home runs and 18 RBI in a 52-game stay in San Francisco.
